before.requirement: Clean rejection by a dump depth limit.
before.reason: The complete old do_dump body has no depth-limit rejection.

after.requirement: Reach the supported clean rejection when dumping a valid constructed value deeper than JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.
after.reason: do_dump rejects at the limit, and the added API test constructs deeper arrays for this behavior. The old harness only dumps successfully parsed values; parse_value rejects excessive nesting before either dump call.

claims.reason: The after source adds a dump failure for deep constructed values. The fixed harness has no route to supply such a value to either dump mode.

before.requirement: Allow json_dumps to produce indented string output for a parsed array or object when the input selects a nonzero indent.
before.reason: json_dumps forwards its flags to serialization, where a nonzero indent emits a newline and spaces. The harness clears every indent bit on the json_dumps call.

after.requirement: Allow json_dumps to produce indented string output for a parsed array or object when the input selects a nonzero indent.
after.reason: The same indentation contract remains, and the old harness still clears the indent bits before json_dumps.

claims.reason: The same unconditional indent mask blocks the same json_dumps behavior before and after the change.
